title: Mass bound for a current defined by pull-back along the dilation η_{x,r}
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, X, Y ∈ D_n(ℝ^P), x ∈ ℝ^P and r > 0. Assume (A) for every ω ∈ D^n(ℝ^P) there is η ∈ D^n(ℝ^P) with η(y) = (rⁿ)⁻¹ω(r⁻¹(y − x)) for all y, and (B) Y(ω) = X(η) whenever η(y) = (rⁿ)⁻¹ω(r⁻¹(y − x)) for all y. Then M_W(Y) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal((rⁿ)⁻¹)·M_{{y : r⁻¹(y−x) ∈ W}}(X) for every W ⊆ ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (X Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) n) (x : Eucl P) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) n, ∃ η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) n, ∀ y, (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) y = (r ^ n)⁻¹ • (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) (r⁻¹ • (y - x))) → (∀ ω η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) n, (∀ y, (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) y = (r ^ n)⁻¹ • (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) (r⁻¹ • (y - x))) → Y ω = X η) → ∀ W : Set (Eucl P), Y.massOn W ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((r ^ n)⁻¹) * X.massOn {y | r⁻¹ • (y - x) ∈ W}
